# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 release candidate** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews Skia m154 and moves API documentation into compiler XML. HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the bundled native source; review the renamed combining-class member and removed aggregate glyph flag before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 renamed to CCC132** — The HarfBuzz upstream spelling correction retains numeric value 132 but removes the compatibility alias. Replace references to CCC133 with CCC132. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **GlyphFlags.Defined removed** — The aggregate Defined mask is no longer exposed because it is not an independent option. Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your application instead. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **RAW and DNG decoding disabled** — The bundled codec no longer decodes RAW or DNG images. Decode these formats with a dedicated library and provide a supported raster image to SkiaSharp instead. ([#5190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5190))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — The bundled renderer moves to Chrome milestone 154 and incorporates current buffer-upload and upstream bug-fix syncs. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))

## API Surface

- **Compiler XML API documentation** — Package consumers receive compiler-generated XML documentation sidecars, with public API documentation authored alongside the C# declarations. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Bindings generated from bundled HarfBuzz** — HarfBuzzSharp generation now uses the HarfBuzz revision pinned by Skia, keeping supported managed declarations synchronized with the bundled native library. ([#5056](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5056), [#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **View documentation supports Markdown remarks** — API documentation remarks can now retain Markdown formatting in generated consumer documentation. ([#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp bindings now generate from the DEPS-pinned native source. The update corrects the CCC132 member name and removes the aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask.
